run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-16T15:23:07Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on frontend-proxy is a propagated symptom of failing checkout traffic, not a fault in the proxy. In the default window (14:23:07–15:40:32Z) frontend-proxy's own span-error rate on operations 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress' rose from a 0.004–0.019/s baseline to 0.044/s at the 15:24:07 evaluation and ~0.45–0.49/s from 15:28 to 15:36, while its total call rate stayed ~9–10/s (no traffic surge). Trace evidence shows the 500s propagate down a single path: frontend-proxy ingress/egress 500 -> frontend POST /api/checkout 500 -> checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder gRPC 13 -> checkout HTTP POST to shipping -> shipping '/get-quote' error 'Internal Server Error' -> shipping client span 'POST quote' error 'Timeout' (~5.0 s), with checkout's propagated message 'shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500'. The deepest abnormal signal is the shipping->quote hop: shipping's 'POST quote' p95 went from ~47 ms to 9,400–9,724 ms from 15:26 to 15:39 while shipping's attempt rate stayed ~0.51–0.57/s, whereas the quote service's own 'POST /getquote' handler p95 stayed flat at ~1.90–1.98 ms and its received request rate fell from ~0.55/s to ~0.09/s (5/6 of calls never reached the handler). In two slow-but-successful traces the shipping client span lasted 2.087 s / 1.019 s while quote's handler span lasted 331 µs / 256 µs and started 2.086 s / 1.018 s after the client span began and ended ~0.2 ms before it, i.e. the time was spent getting the request to quote, not inside the quote handler and not on the response. Pod-level checks found no crash, restart, eviction, OOM, endpoint mismatch or CPU throttling change, so the evidence localises the impairment to the shipping pod's outbound path to quote:8080. The error text's claim that a POST to the email service got a 500 could not be verified: the email service's own sampled server spans returned http.status_code 200 in 3.4–5.3 ms and its traffic fell in step with completed checkouts, so that part remains unknown.

claims.text: frontend-proxy's own span error rate rose on both operations in the alert window: traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="frontend-proxy",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"} rate for span_name 'ingress' and for span_name 'router frontend egress' went from 0.0037–0.0185/s (15:01–15:23) to 0.0444/s at 15:24:07, 0.2667/s at 15:26:07, ~0.45–0.49/s from 15:28:07 to 15:36:07, and back to 0 at 15:40:07, while the STATUS_CODE_UNSET (non-error) rate stayed ~9.24–10.49/s.

The frontend-proxy error spans are HTTP 500s on span 'ingress' and span 'router frontend egress' (status tags error=true, http.status_code=500, otel.status_code=ERROR) and each is the parent chain of an errored frontend 'POST /api/checkout' span (http.status_code 500) and an errored frontend gRPC client span 'grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' (rpc.grpc.status_code 13).

The propagated error text on checkout's 'oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' span (otel.status_description and exception.message) is exactly 'shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500', returned with rpc.grpc.status_code 13.

Inside the failing checkout path, shipping produced span '/get-quote' with otel.status_description 'Internal Server Error' (duration 5,001,042 µs) and its child client span 'POST quote' with otel.status_description 'Timeout' (duration 5,000,995 µs); no quote service span appears in that trace.

shipping span 'POST quote' p95 latency went from 47.2 ms (15:24:07) to 9,400.5–9,724.6 ms at every evaluation from 15:26:07 to 15:39:07, while quote's own span 'POST /getquote' p95 stayed at 1.90–1.98 ms across the whole window including the incident.

shipping kept attempting quote calls at its normal rate during the incident (span rate for 'POST quote' and '/get-quote' remained 0.511–0.572/s from 15:24:07 to 15:36:07), while quote's received request rate (span_name 'POST /getquote') fell from ~0.544/s at 15:24:07 to 0.085–0.097/s from 15:28:07 onward.

At 15:36:00 the 'POST quote' duration histogram totalled 0.511/s, with 0.444/s of calls in the 5–10 s buckets, 0.0667/s at or below 5 s and only 0.0185/s at or below 10 ms — i.e. most calls stalled 5–10 s rather than failing fast.

Two slow-but-successful traces show the delay outside quote's handler: shipping 'POST quote' spans of 2,086,599 µs and 1,018,563 µs whose child quote spans 'POST /getquote' lasted only 331 µs and 256 µs; quote's span started 2,086,023 µs and 1,018,090 µs after the shipping client span started and ended 245 µs and 217 µs before the client span ended.

frontend-proxy user-facing latency rose with the same timing: p95 of span 'ingress' went from 304–613 ms before 15:24 to 886 ms (15:26:07), 1,381 ms (15:28:07), 3,845 ms (15:30:07) and 1,820 ms (15:39:07).

Per-service error-span totals for 14:23:07–15:40:32 are frontend 1529, frontend-proxy 792, shipping 770, checkout 765; accounting and payment returned 0, and quote, email, cart, currency, product-catalog, kafka, load-generator and image-provider have no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series in this result (unknown, not zero).

The hop p95 comparison isolates the anomaly: checkout span 'HTTP POST' to shipping rose 66–75 ms -> 9,596–9,678 ms and shipping '/get-quote' 38–70 ms -> 9,698–9,725 ms, while checkout 'oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert' (79–98 ms) and frontend 'grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct' (89–120 ms) stayed flat.

All 21 otel-demo pods were Running and Ready with 0 restarts at query time; email-59f69bc6cf-8z5c5, quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w and shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv all show restartCount 0 with containers running since 14:46:2xZ, and all 21 deployments report 1 replica ready/available/updated.

Service/endpoint wiring is correct: the 'quote' Service selects opentelemetry.io/name=quote and its only endpoint is 100.96.1.165:8080 -> pod quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w with no not-ready addresses, and shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv (100.96.1.109) and quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w (100.96.1.165) run on the same node i-0b4b26fa385533a10.

Deployment env config matches the observed call direction: shipping has QUOTE_ADDR=http://quote:8080, checkout has SHIPPING_ADDR=http://shipping:8080 and EMAIL_ADDR=http://email:8080, and quote listens on QUOTE_PORT=8080 — so shipping's quote client is configured to POST to the quote service, not the email service.

Container CPU throttling did not change with the incident: throttled-periods ratio for quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w was 3.9–8.5% and for shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv 3.6–10.4% across 14:23–15:40 (checkout 0%), and their CPU usage rates fell during the incident (quote 0.00128 -> 0.00019 cores; shipping 0.00076 -> 0.00050 cores).

Email service spans sampled at 15:32:54–15:32:56Z returned http.status_code=200: 'POST /send_order_confirmation' spans of 3,424 µs and 5,325 µs with internal 'send_email' spans of 2,697 µs and 4,346 µs, inside checkouts that completed with rpc.grpc.status_code 0.

The email service has no ERROR-status span series at all (only span_name POST /send_order_confirmation, send_email and sinatra.render_template with status_code STATUS_CODE_UNSET), and its span rate fell from 0.544/s at 15:24:07 to 0.085–0.097/s from 15:28:07 onward, in lockstep with completed checkouts rather than with failing ones.

The fault localises to the shipping pod's outbound request path to quote:8080 (delay and/or packet loss on shipping's egress), which explains all three observations at once: shipping's client spans of 5–10 s, quote receiving only ~1/6 of shipping's attempts, and the elapsed time appearing before quote's handler starts while quote's response returns in ~0.2 ms. Chaos/network impairment (e.g. tc netem delay+loss) applied to pod shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv is the most consistent mechanism, but it is a hypothesis, not an observed configuration.

A second, not fully excluded candidate is an impairment on the quote pod's own ingress/accept path (packets arriving late at quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w rather than leaving shipping late). The request-leg/response-leg split that favours shipping depends on comparable clocks across pods, which was not measured, and both pods sit on node i-0b4b26fa385533a10.

The propagated message names the email service, but the email service's own telemetry does not show failures: its sampled server spans return http.status_code 200 in 3.4–5.3 ms, it emits no ERROR-status spans at all, and its request rate fell (fewer completed checkouts) instead of showing retried/failed calls — so the email-service part of the error text is unverified rather than established.

There is no sign of a reconfiguration or rollout that could explain an address change: the shipping pod started at 14:46:25Z (before the 15:23 onset) with restartCount 0 and was never recreated, so QUOTE_ADDR=http://quote:8080 was in place before the incident.

Rejected: resource limits / CPU throttling of shipping, quote or email caused the latency. Throttled-period ratios were 3.6–10.4% with no upward step at the 15:23 onset, CPU usage of quote and shipping actually decreased during the incident, and checkout's throttle ratio was 0.

Rejected: quote application latency/slowness caused the timeouts. quote's own server span 'POST /getquote' p95 stayed at 1.90–1.98 ms throughout, and in the two observed slow traces the handler contributed only 331 µs and 256 µs of 2.087 s and 1.019 s client waits.

Rejected: frontend-proxy itself broke. Its 500 spans are error=true on 'ingress' whose child 'router frontend egress' and the downstream frontend POST /api/checkout and checkout PlaceOrder spans carry the same 500/gRPC-13 errors and the originating shipping quote error, so the proxy is relaying failures rather than originating them.

Rejected: pod crash, OOM, eviction or rollout of the involved workloads. All 21 otel-demo pods are Running/Ready with 0 restarts, shipping/quote/email containers have no previous terminated instance and have been running since 14:46:2xZ, and all deployments report 1/1 ready/available/updated.

Rejected: Service selector/endpoint misconfiguration or wrong target addresses. The quote Service selector and its single ready endpoint (100.96.1.165:8080 -> quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w) match the running pod, and shipping's QUOTE_ADDR points at quote:8080.

Inspect the network path from pod shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv to quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w (and any chaos/netem rule or CNI policy targeting the shipping pod's egress to quote:8080 or the quote pod's ingress) for the 15:23–15:40Z period on node i-0b4b26fa385533a10, and check the shipping pod's DNS resolution path, since unresolved/late egress requests would also explain the 5/6 of quote calls that never arrived.

If the 'POST to email service ... got 500' text is taken as a real second fault, collect the email container's request/access logs for 15:23–15:40Z (application stdout currently yields no lines) and review the shipping quote client's error-string formatting, because the trace path shows shipping's POST going to quote:8080, not to email:8080.

gaps: No alert-rule evidence: list_prometheus_rules for rule_name RequestErrorRate returned no_data, so the alert's exact expression/threshold and whether it is still firing could not be verified; the alert annotation value 0.6444444444444444 is only context, and the observed frontend-proxy error-span rate peaks near 0.49/s with a total call rate near 9.3/s.

No network telemetry: no container_network_* or node_netstat_* series exist in this target, so packet loss/delay and TCP retransmissions cannot be confirmed directly, and shipping-egress vs quote-ingress cannot be separated by network counters.
Cross-pod clock skew was not measured; the request-leg-vs-response-leg split relies on the shipping and quote span timestamps being directly comparable.

Email service runtime behaviour is unverified: fetch_pod_logs for email-59f69bc6cf-8z5c5 returned 0 lines over 14:40–15:40Z with no previous container instance, so whether email ever returned HTTP 500 during the window could not be checked beyond the sampled 200 spans.
quote and email emit no STATUS_CODE_ERROR span series (all spans are STATUS_CODE_UNSET), so absence of error status on them is not evidence of success; only sampled spans were observed.

Kubernetes events for otel-demo in the window returned only 'Updated' events for quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w and a no_data result once 'Updated' was filtered out; a no_data view cannot prove that no probe-failure, kill or eviction events occurred, and quote/shipping have no readiness/liveness probes configured at all.
change_history integration is not integrated, so whether a chaos experiment or configuration change was applied at ~15:23Z could not be confirmed.

Only representative pods and workloads were inspected (shipping, quote, email, checkout plus the full pod/deployment listings); the ~3 error spans each on ad, fraud-detection and recommendation were not investigated and are not tied to this cause.
next_steps: Review network chaos/experiment records and CNI (tc/netem, iptables) state for node i-0b4b26fa385533a10 covering pods shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv and quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w at 15:23–15:40Z.
Check kubelet/CNI and DNS (CoreDNS/NodeLocal DNS) logs for the shipping pod's node during the window to test the unresolved-egress/DNS hypothesis.

Collect email service request logs or enable email access logging for 15:23–15:40Z to settle whether the 'POST to email service' 500 is a real event, and review the shipping quote client's error message source.
Review the shipping HTTP client's quote timeout/retry settings (observed 5,000,995 µs timeout spans and 5–10 s stalls) so a single slow dependency does not turn checkout into 500s.

There is no sign of a reconfiguration or rollout that could explain an address change: the shipping pod started at 14:46:25Z (before the 15:23 onset) with restartCount 0 and was never recreated, so QUOTE_ADDR=http://quote:8080 was in place before the incident.

rejected_hypothesis.text: Rejected: resource limits / CPU throttling of shipping, quote or email caused the latency. Throttled-period ratios were 3.6–10.4% with no upward step at the 15:23 onset, CPU usage of quote and shipping actually decreased during the incident, and checkout's throttle ratio was 0.

Rejected: quote application latency/slowness caused the timeouts. quote's own server span 'POST /getquote' p95 stayed at 1.90–1.98 ms throughout, and in the two observed slow traces the handler contributed only 331 µs and 256 µs of 2.087 s and 1.019 s client waits.

Rejected: frontend-proxy itself broke. Its 500 spans are error=true on 'ingress' whose child 'router frontend egress' and the downstream frontend POST /api/checkout and checkout PlaceOrder spans carry the same 500/gRPC-13 errors and the originating shipping quote error, so the proxy is relaying failures rather than originating them.

Rejected: pod crash, OOM, eviction or rollout of the involved workloads. All 21 otel-demo pods are Running/Ready with 0 restarts, shipping/quote/email containers have no previous terminated instance and have been running since 14:46:2xZ, and all deployments report 1/1 ready/available/updated.

Rejected: Service selector/endpoint misconfiguration or wrong target addresses. The quote Service selector and its single ready endpoint (100.96.1.165:8080 -> quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w) match the running pod, and shipping's QUOTE_ADDR points at quote:8080.
